acceptance_predicates.description: An omitted channel resolves to dev for a fresh installation and explicit dev is accepted.
The selected channel is preserved through install, status, launch, upgrade, rollback, and remove.
stable, nightly, and experimental are typed unavailable in this development build and never silently fall back.
Human-default output and explicit --json output expose the resolved channel and typed diagnostics.
Missing authentication, signatures, and key management remain visible development-only warnings and never block dev.

definition_of_done: Exact current-head ASB/TUI lifecycle tests pass for default, explicit, persistence, restart, rollback, remove, and unavailable channels.
Independent review and hosted checks pass with no secret-shaped output.

inputs.description: Optional channel selection from supported ASB/TUI commands.
dev, stable, nightly, and experimental channel identities.

outputs.description: Persisted typed channel selection and human/JSON lifecycle diagnostics.

gates.description: Unavailable explicit channels never silently resolve to another channel.
Restart and lifecycle operations preserve the selected channel or report a typed unavailable state.
